articles.title: US Dollar: Supported but capped by CPI risks – OCBC
articles.expand: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong argue the US Dollar (USD) remains supported by higher Oil prices, firm US yields and resilient Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations, but not yet breaking out of its recent range.
